scope: All unmatched outflows at the configured material threshold within 90 days of each retained vault/token/chain endpoint, plus explicitly listed older and later cases.

decisions.finding: The retained case assessment documents the swap/exchange route; the bounded recipient query did not add a further original-token transfer. The earlier assessment records a near-matching Ethereum return after the exchange route, supporting possible cross-chain balancing rather than proving it.
decisions.limitation: Observed disposition and possible counterpart links do not establish payment purpose, beneficial ownership or accepted redemption. Earlier/additional recipient funds can prevent allocation of later payments. Reopen on a shared settlement identifier, reliable attribution or fuller history.
